B.  CONSENT CALENDAR

1.  WAIVE READING IN FULL OF ALL ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS ON THE AGENDA
  That the City Council waive reading in full of all ordinances and resolutions on the agenda and
  declare that said titles which appear on the public agenda shall be determined to have been read
  by title and further reading waived.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Farfan, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Del Rio, to adopt the
  Consent Calendar as presented, in its entirety.

  The motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 4; Farfan, Roa, Del Rio, De Paula
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 1; Vargas
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion carried: 4–0–1–0

2.  Recommendation to receive and file warrants processed during the period of March 15 to March

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

C.  DISCUSSION ITEM(S)

1.  Recommendation to discuss and consider approving a donation to Fedde Academy.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Denise Macias, Principal, Fedde Academy, spoke.

  Melanie Payumo, Teacher, Fedde Academy, spoke.

  Councilmember Roa spoke.

  Mayor Pro Tem Del Rio spoke.

  A motion was made by Mayor Pro Tem Del Rio, seconded by Councilmember Roa, to approve a
  $5,000 donation to Fedde Academy.

  The motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 4; Farfan, Roa, Del Rio, De Paula
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 1; Vargas
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion carried: 4–0–1–0

D.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

E.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced that the City Carnival will be
held on April 11­13, 2025; and the Easter Event will be held on April 19, 2015.

F.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

There were no Oral City Attorney Reports.

G.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Mayor De Paula congratulated Mayor Pro Tem Del Rio and Shavon Moore, Executive Assistant, for
winning the 2025 Women of Distinction award from the California State Assembly.
